summary: Destinus is european private aerospace company, founded in 2021. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 1 about growth or hiring; 7 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: Destinus is a European defence company building drones, interceptors and missiles, with Dutch sites in Hengelo and Valkenburg, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Builds unmanned aerial vehicles and air-defence systems for governments and defence organisations worldwide.
Its current Dutch roles are director-level finance jobs in Valkenburg and Hengelo.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor via Destinus Energy B.V., Destinus NL B.V. and Destinus OPRA B.V.
Both current jobs here don't require Dutch.

growth.text: Will supply interceptor drones to the Dutch and Danish navies.
Expanded its partnership with Thales on NATO air defence, counter-drone interceptors and long-range strike production.
Rheinmetall is advancing Destinus production plans, citing battlefield demand in Ukraine.

worth_knowing.text: This is weapons work: reports describe first combat use of its Ruta Block 1 cruise missile in Russia.
A joint Aeon-Destinus interceptor proposal reached the US Army xTech finals.
